parsed.name: Heraeus Cytomat自动微孔板培养存储系统
parsed.description: 这是一种用于自动化实验流程的微孔板培养与存储设备，带有温度控制、振荡和传送工位，可在内部板架中存放微孔板，并通过舱门与装载托盘完成进出板。常用于细胞培养、样品孵育以及与机器人联用的高通量实验流程。
parsed.description_en: An automated microplate incubator and storage unit for laboratory automation workflows. It provides temperature control, shaking, and a transfer/loading station to move plates between internal racks and external handlers. It is used for microplate incubation, storage, and robotic high-throughput laboratory workflows.
